name: Overall job-market opportunity
preliminary_rationale: Core relocation question with strong national labour indicators; vacancy depth and occupational matching need care.

name: Skilled-work visa accessibility
preliminary_rationale: One of the most important relocation gates, but policy rules are volatile, conditional and difficult to encode comparably.

name: Permanent-residency accessibility
preliminary_rationale: Core long-term settlement question; needs transparent scenario definitions and current official policy evidence.

name: Average earning potential
preliminary_rationale: Core economic outcome, but national averages and gross wages can mislead without taxes, household type and city costs.

name: Personal income-tax burden
preliminary_rationale: Core relocation input; effective burden by household and income scenario is preferable to headline rates.

name: Housing affordability
preliminary_rationale: Extremely decision-relevant, but meaningful data is usually city-level and rent/home-price definitions differ.

name: Healthcare system capacity and quality
preliminary_rationale: Core family decision area and natural successor to stale UHC; must separate capacity, outcomes, access and migrant eligibility.

name: English usability
preliminary_rationale: High day-to-day and employment value; combine population proficiency carefully with actual service availability.

name: Overall higher-education opportunity
preliminary_rationale: Directly relevant to students and families; likely measurable, but quality and access should be kept separate.

name: Existing immigrant share
preliminary_rationale: Clear national structural measure and likely broad official coverage; interpretation should separate share from welcome or integration.

name: Software and technology jobs
preliminary_rationale: Highly relevant for Konsider's likely early users, but jobs cluster in a few cities and occupation taxonomies vary.

name: Internet access, speed, and reliability
preliminary_rationale: Strong daily-life criterion with broad digital indicators; reliability and speed need more than subscription counts.

name: Electricity access and reliability
preliminary_rationale: Basic reliability is more useful than access alone; outage data may be less universal than electrification.

name: School education quality
preliminary_rationale: High family relevance and plausible official outcomes, though national averages hide local and school-type variation.

name: Extreme-weather risk
preliminary_rationale: Important environmental risk with plausible hazard data; define event frequency, exposure and resilience separately.

name: Professional-licensing accessibility for immigrants
preliminary_rationale: Critical for medical and other regulated professions, but origin, profession and credential dependence makes it a likely profile layer.

name: Post-study migration pathway
preliminary_rationale: Critical for students; should be researched as a policy pathway distinct from university quality.

name: Family reunification support
preliminary_rationale: High family value; dependant categories and sponsor rules vary and change frequently.

name: Citizenship accessibility
preliminary_rationale: Important for permanence, but time-to-citizenship and dual-citizenship rules need profile-specific qualification.

name: Research and innovation ecosystem
preliminary_rationale: Strong national innovation signal with plausible official inputs; avoid double counting education and tech jobs.

name: Engineering and skilled technical jobs
preliminary_rationale: Useful profession branch with plausible occupation data, but shortages and credential rules vary.

name: Medical and healthcare jobs
preliminary_rationale: Strong demand signal for a major profession, but professional licensing must be separated from vacancies.

name: Business, finance, and professional-services jobs
preliminary_rationale: Useful profession branch; broad occupational definitions may blur finance, consulting and general services.

name: Entrepreneurship and startup opportunity
preliminary_rationale: High economic value with several official components; composite design and redundancy with innovation need control.

name: Employment protection and worker rights
preliminary_rationale: Useful quality-of-work dimension with plausible legal indicators; law and enforcement should not be conflated.

name: Social-security and mandatory contribution burden
preliminary_rationale: Necessary companion to income tax for take-home pay; country systems and benefit entitlements complicate comparison.

name: Healthcare affordability
preliminary_rationale: High family value; distinguish system financing, insurance requirements and migrant eligibility.

name: Savings and disposable-income potential
preliminary_rationale: Best treated as a derived household-profile result from earnings, tax, housing and essentials rather than one raw criterion.

name: Currency and macroeconomic stability
preliminary_rationale: Useful risk dimension with strong national data possibilities; avoid turning short-term volatility into a permanent country label.

name: Political stability and civil peace
preliminary_rationale: High-level safety and continuity signal with plausible broad sources; distinguish conflict exposure from ordinary politics.

name: Rule of law and institutional trust
preliminary_rationale: Strong institutional criterion with broad governance indicators; survey/model uncertainty and licensing need review.

name: Water quality and sanitation
preliminary_rationale: Strong health/infrastructure dimension with plausible broad official indicators; access does not guarantee reliability or taste.

name: Water-supply reliability
preliminary_rationale: High practical value but continuity and scarcity are highly local and seasonally variable.

name: Climate resilience and adaptation readiness
preliminary_rationale: Promising risk-management dimension, though many indices are modelled composites and may embed socioeconomic outcomes.

name: Long-term climate-change exposure
preliminary_rationale: Long-horizon structural risk; model assumptions and scenarios require careful communication.

name: Natural-disaster risk
preliminary_rationale: Broad hazard exposure can complement extreme weather but overlaps it; geophysical and climate hazards may need separate components.

name: International-student accessibility
preliminary_rationale: Decision-relevant for students, but combines admissions, language, visa and support policies that may require multiple sources.

name: Tuition affordability
preliminary_rationale: Useful only when normalized by purchasing power or income; fees vary heavily by institution and residency status.

name: Recognition and portability of qualifications
preliminary_rationale: Valuable for regulated careers and study, but qualification recognition is profession- and origin-specific.

name: Digital-government readiness
preliminary_rationale: Promising institutional convenience measure with emerging official benchmarks; composite transparency is important.

name: Work-life balance
preliminary_rationale: Highly relevant but combines legal entitlements, actual hours, commute and culture; some components are city/profile dependent.

name: Family friendliness
preliminary_rationale: Broad profile-oriented composite overlapping school, childcare, safety, leave and migration rules.

name: Social protection and welfare support
preliminary_rationale: Important for long-term security, but immigrant eligibility and contribution history matter more than nominal generosity.

name: Social inclusion and acceptance of immigrants
preliminary_rationale: Important lived-outcome dimension, but survey comparability, bias and sparse country coverage may limit production use.

name: Government stance toward immigrants
preliminary_rationale: Broad, partly subjective composite that overlaps visa, PR, rights and integration; use components rather than one opaque stance score.

name: Visa and immigration processing efficiency
preliminary_rationale: Useful administrative-quality measure, but comparable official processing-time and rejection-rate data may be incomplete.

name: Immigrant community depth
preliminary_rationale: Valuable for origin-specific users but bilateral and city-level; likely too sparse for one universal score.

name: Technology and engineering education
preliminary_rationale: High value for technical profiles, but institution-level rankings may be commercial or city-concentrated.

name: Medical and health-sciences education
preliminary_rationale: High value for medical students; programme recognition and licensing make simple country scoring difficult.

name: Business, commerce, and management education
preliminary_rationale: Useful sector branch, but likely overlaps the broader higher-education criterion.

name: Remote-work suitability
preliminary_rationale: User-relevant composite but overlaps internet, visas, taxes and jobs; city and time-zone dependence is substantial.

name: Income growth and career mobility
preliminary_rationale: Meaningful long-term outcome but difficult to measure comparably and likely slow or survey-dependent.

name: Consumption and indirect-tax burden
preliminary_rationale: Useful cost input but partly reflected in observed price levels and varies by goods and exemptions.

name: Childcare and family-cost burden
preliminary_rationale: Important for families but city-, age-, household- and policy-specific, with weak global standardization.

name: International-school availability
preliminary_rationale: Important to globally mobile families but primarily city-level and likely dependent on non-government directories.

name: International connectivity
preliminary_rationale: Relevant for migrants and travel, but airport/city concentration and commercial schedule data complicate national scoring.

name: Transport and logistics infrastructure
preliminary_rationale: Useful national infrastructure component but overlaps the existing experimental composite and may favor trade over residents.

name: Urban public transport
preliminary_rationale: Highly useful for actual movers, but inherently metropolitan and difficult to normalize globally.

name: Temperature comfort
preliminary_rationale: Strong user relevance but primarily city/regional and preference-dependent; national annual averages are misleading.

name: Climate preference fit
preliminary_rationale: Should be a user preference-match model, not a universal higher-is-better score.

name: Environmental quality beyond PM2.5
preliminary_rationale: Too broad as one measure and overlaps pollution, water, waste, biodiversity and urban quality.

name: Cultural openness and diversity
preliminary_rationale: Broad and subjective; likely overlaps immigrant inclusion, rights and diversity measures.

name: Religious freedom and freedom of expression
preliminary_rationale: Meaningful rights criterion with plausible legal measures; legal protections and lived practice should remain distinct.

name: LGBTQ+ legal and social inclusion
preliminary_rationale: Potentially measurable through law and rights datasets, but lived safety and social acceptance should be separated.

name: Property-crime and everyday safety
preliminary_rationale: High practical value but reporting practices and victimization survey coverage are inconsistent; city effects are large.

name: Emergency-care readiness
preliminary_rationale: Important but operational emergency metrics are rarely globally standardized and are often local.

name: Mental-health support
preliminary_rationale: Important lived need, yet provider access, affordability and stigma are difficult to compare globally.

name: Food safety and public-health protection
preliminary_rationale: Useful in principle, but comparable inspection and outbreak-response measures are fragmented.

name: Overall life satisfaction
preliminary_rationale: Useful outcome check, not a causal relocation criterion; survey culture and annual volatility require caution.

name: Recreation, culture, and leisure
preliminary_rationale: Useful for lifestyle exploration, but subjective, city-level and unlikely to justify early production effort.

name: Quality of urban life
preliminary_rationale: Attractive product concept but primarily city-level and highly composite.

name: Local-language difficulty and learning burden
preliminary_rationale: Inherently depends on the user's known languages and learning context; suited to preference/profile logic.

name: Retirement suitability
preliminary_rationale: Profile composite rather than universal country property; overlaps the dedicated retirement profile.

name: Overall affordability
preliminary_rationale: Already represented by Konsider's broad household price-level criterion; retain as baseline, not new Phase 5 research.

name: Gender equality
preliminary_rationale: Already represented by women's legal and economic equality; lived-outcome expansion may be researched separately later.

name: Violent-crime and homicide safety
preliminary_rationale: Already represented by intentional homicide; broader violent crime is not automatically comparable.

name: Air pollution
preliminary_rationale: Already represented by population-weighted PM2.5; city air-quality detail belongs to a future layer.

name: Infrastructure readiness composite
preliminary_rationale: Existing experimental composite; Phase 5 should evaluate components and redundancy rather than treat it as a new criterion.

name: Suitability for a software professional
preliminary_rationale: Explicit profile composite built from approved independent criteria; do not search for a separate source.

name: Suitability for a medical professional
preliminary_rationale: Explicit profile composite with licensing and language dependencies; do not treat as standalone data.

name: Suitability for a student
preliminary_rationale: Explicit profile composite combining education, affordability, safety and migration pathways.

name: Suitability for a family with school-age children
preliminary_rationale: Explicit family profile composite; should be calculated after component criteria mature.

name: Suitability for an entrepreneur
preliminary_rationale: Explicit entrepreneur profile composite; avoid duplicating its underlying business, tax and migration criteria.

name: Suitability for retirement
preliminary_rationale: Explicit retirement profile composite and near-duplicate of retirement suitability; calculate from components.
